delivery.commit_subject: BP5-GCP-001: add nonprod GCP identity baseline

handoffs.message: Implementation ready for review. Added repo-local nonprod GCP baseline bootstrap (WIF, pantheon-cloud-build SA, runtime SAs, secret-level Secret Manager IAM), documented operator flow in deployment and remote-dev docs, and fixed dry-run project-number handling so WIF output stays explicit during rehearsal.

Review approved: WIF, runtime SAs, secret namespace and secret-level IAM are explicit and executable; operator flow is documented as environment truth in v2 deploy doc and remote-dev doc. Minor dry-run warning unreachability is follow-on, not a blocker.
